# Fonts (vendored)

Barlow Condensed Bold, Bold Italic and ExtraBold Italic, Copyright 2017 The Barlow
Project Authors (https://github.com/jpt/barlow), SIL Open Font License 1.1
(`LICENSES/BarlowCondensed-OFL-1.1.txt`). Unmodified, from
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/barlowcondensed. Used for the
first-run screens and the settings menu: headings, labels, rows and buttons
(ui/burnout_setup.cpp, ui/settings_menu.cpp).
